cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. If someone offered twenty pounds, would you still keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll admit I sleep with the cushion. Could you take the price sticker off before I sit?
